decision: The competitor (Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team) is fined €25,000
event_name: Date 01 October 2022 Time 23:23 2022 SINGAPORE GRAND PRIX 29 September - 02 October 2022 The Stewards Title Offence - Mercedes - Inaccurate Scrutineering Form Description Offence - Mercedes - Inaccurate Scrutineering Form
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter III of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative. As required by Article 31.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, prior to P1 the team submitted a self-scrutiny form for Car 44 by which they declared that the driver complied with the requirement not to wear jewellery in the form of body piercing. That declaration was incorrect in the case of HAM who had a nose piercing which he had not removed. The Team Manager explained that the team was unaware that HAM had a piercing. In recent events HAM had removed the piercing prior to the competition. The team assumed, without enquiring of HAM, that he had followed or would follow the same procedure for this event. The Stewards accept that the error in the declaration in this case was not intentional or deliberate but it would not have occurred had the team made an enquiry of HAM before completing and submitting the declaration. Given these circumstances, we fine the team € 25,000.
